items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (calf) officially ACTIVE vs Raiders. Optimistic Saturday reports held; feeling better, no setbacks expected.
items.why: Calf issue; DNP Friday but improved Saturday; McVay/sources confident.
items.implication: Lock in as elite WR1; full or near-full routes expected in favorable matchup. Update projections immediately.
items.opportunity: Primary target share with Adams out; high snap/route volume.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) officially INACTIVE vs Dolphins after missing three games. Unlikely earlier per sources; not full participant.
items.why: Quad strain; limited practice, early in return process.
items.implication: Sit Hall; pivot to backup lead back in soft matchup vs Miami. Clear volume opportunity for Jets RB committee lead.
items.opportunity: Full backfield snaps/carries for primary backup; goal-line and third-down work.

items.text: ETR Sunday morning summary: Puka GTD/OPT, Breece GTD/PESS, Saquon expected, Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson IN, Lamar/Smith/Wicks OUT. Projections updated.
items.why: Weekend reports aggregated; gold-standard for fantasy.
items.implication: Direct + implied opportunities; update all lineups/projections. Matches Schefter/Rap/Levitan tightly.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries from OUTs (PHI pass, Jets RB, Ravens); elevated roles for INs.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) ruled OUT for Monday Night vs Cowboys.
items.why: Hamstring for Smith, ankle for Wicks; final injury report.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in PHI pass game. Elevate remaining pass-catchers; Berry had loved Smith pre-ruling.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Goedert, secondary WRs; possible more Hurts designed runs or checkdowns.
items.conflict: Berry LOVE on Smith pre-OUT now void.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley starts again. Misses third straight.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice but ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Fade Ravens pass game ceiling; Huntley limits dual-threat upside. Henry/Flowers/Andrews still viable but lower volume potential.
items.opportunity: Increased checkdowns and run game reliance possible.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey went to locker room during game then returned. Earlier Levitan noted temptation to slot him more as WR amid 49ers WR outs (Evans/Deebo/Kirk situation).
items.why: In-game departure then return; prior comments on slot WR role with WR injuries.
items.implication: Monitor for any lingering issue; elevated receiving role possible with Kirk debut and other WRs out. Rarely buy RB-as-WR fully but 49ers dire.
items.opportunity: Potential increased routes/slot snaps, targets in addition to carries.
items.conflict: Levitan rarely buys RB-WR hybrid statements but tempted here.

items.text: Actives/activations expected to play: Texans WR Tank Dell (first action in ~2 years), 49ers WR Christian Kirk (IR activation, debut), Vikings RB Jordan Mason (IR). Also Baker Mayfield active, Dylan Sampson.
items.implication: Dell immediate WR depth/upside in HOU; Kirk opportunity with Evans/Deebo OUT in SF (boosts CMC too); Mason committee piece in MIN.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Dell/Kirk; carries for Mason.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs Cowboys; questionable but trending right after returning to practice. Efficient in prior full games.
items.why: Hamstring; practiced, sources/ETR optimistic for MNF.
items.implication: Start with confidence if active; strong RB matchup vs Dallas. Monitor final inactive.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps, carries, receiving work if cleared.
corroboration: Matthew Berry ranks RB15 if active

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated/IN and expected to play Sunday after layoff. Confirmed in ETR summary and Schefter activations.
items.why: Activated; Schefter lists among expected to play.
items.implication: Monitor workload post-layoff; Berry HATES due to rust/volume questions vs DET. Still RB starter if cleared fully.
items.opportunity: Lead carries but possible pitch count; handcuff/committee risk.
items.conflict: Berry HATE post-layoff vs volume expectation.

items.text: Jonah Coleman (Broncos, activated from IR) should be rostered in 100% of leagues. End-of-year RB you wish you had; prior 13 touches/TD before injury. Dobbins/Harvey inefficient.
items.why: Designated return; early-season production; committee inefficiency.
items.implication: Immediate add/roster everywhere; potential lead or committee winner ROS.

items.text: Lamar, Puka, Breece statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky scratches: Egbuka, BRob, Warren (Tyler), Jahwar Jordan. Tempted by CMC slot WR role amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism. Projections fully updated.
items.why: Injury leverage + usage data; 49ers WR dire situation + Kaelon Black presence.
items.implication: Prioritize early news on trio; fade missed scratches; CMC receiving bump possible. Matches ETR perfectly.
items.opportunity: CMC routes/targets expansion; clear backups for outs.
items.conflict: Usual fade of RB-as-WR hype but exception here.

items.text: OUTs include Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel (SF), Davante Adams (LAR), Rashee Rice, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Brian Robinson, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery. Confirmed multiple sources.
items.why: Injury reports; Adams IR-ish, others designated.
items.implication: Clear role expansions: SF (Kirk/CMC/Kittle), LAR (Puka full, Higbee), KC (Worthy etc), TB, others. Handcuffs elevate.
items.opportunity: Snap/target/carry shares to next-men-up; red-zone shifts.

items.text: Broncos CB Pat Surtain II (ankle) officially inactive; unlikely earlier, good chance next week. Boosts opposing pass catchers (e.g. vs AZ).
items.implication: Upgrade AZ pass catchers (MHJ, Wilson, McBride) vs weakened DEN secondary.

items.text: Inactives include Titans WR Calvin Ridley; Actives include Bucs QB Baker Mayfield (thumb return).
items.implication: Fade Ridley; start Mayfield confidently in return. Titans WR opportunity shifts.
items.opportunity: Mayfield full snaps; TEN secondary WR/TE bumps.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected as lead back (per Insiders/GameDay). Also Jacobs return context.
items.implication: Start/elevate Skattebo for volume vs HOU; Berry had as Hate in tough spot but role clear.

items.text: Berry top-10 overall Week 7 rankings heading into Sunday feature Puka high (pre-active confirmation). Later confirmed Puka active.
items.why: Elite production/matchup faith despite limited practice.
items.implication: WR1 priority start once active; aligns with ETR/Levitan optimism.

items.text: Berry LOVES A.J. Brown (usage/matchup vs CHI) and Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET Lions D allowing many TE TDs/points). Also volume RBs Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving.
items.why: Bears good for yardage; Lions D gift to pass catchers/TEs (9 TE TDs); big workloads + friendly matchups for RBs.
items.implication: Start/elevate these; Kraft strong TE streamer/play. Volume > recent points.
items.opportunity: High target/route shares, red-zone for Kraft; carry/target volume for RBs.

items.text: Berry HATES Rome Odunze (shadow by Gonzalez, outside targets), Josh Downs (target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (tough SEA D), Josh Jacobs (post-layoff workload questions).
items.why: Nasty matchups/shadows, role/target issues, rust after absence.
items.implication: Fade/sit in favor of better spots; Jacobs monitor snaps post-activation.
items.conflict: Jacobs IN/active conflicts with Hate on volume.
